name: list_workouts
description: Returns the athlete's planned workouts and race/test events for a date range (each with id, name, category, start_date_local, and a description with intensity and purpose). Use it to see the athlete's training for a date range.

oldest.description: First day of the range, inclusive, as a local date yyyy-MM-dd (America/Bogota).

newest.description: Last day of the range, inclusive, as a local date yyyy-MM-dd (America/Bogota).
